title: Correct consent
purpose: Correct a transcription error in the consent's current record.

sections.title: How a correction works
paragraphs: The correction is added as a new version that replaces the current record; the earlier version stays in the records history with its values struck through. A change of the participant's decision is a new consent record, not a correction. Only the current record can be corrected. If the form version changes, saving shows the new version's categories to answer first.

items.label: Consent form version, Decision, Date of the decision, Expires on, Who decided, How it was documented, Answers per category, Where the original is filed, Restrictions
items.description: As on Record consent, filled in from the current record. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Reason for the correction
items.description: Required: what was transcribed wrongly. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can open or submit this form; other roles are refused. The server repeats every check when you save.
The form opens in a dialog over the page you came from; opened directly it is a full page. Cancel returns to that page without saving.

After saving you return to the consent's records. If someone else changed the record since you opened the form, the save is refused with a message to reload; the form keeps your entries and the next save uses the current version, so check the current values first.
